levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Conversation covered fewer than three of the four listed topics, per the checklist and the task 3 list.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four topics were discussed and appear, in some form, in the task 3 list.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All four topics are covered with an item that reflects an actual point made in the conversation, not a generic restatement of the topic.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Items are vague fairness statements with no specific mechanism, such as 'split evenly.'

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least four of the five to six items name a specific, workable mechanism.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All items name a specific mechanism, and at least one anticipates a likely disagreement, like an early move-out, with a concrete plan.

criteria.dimension: Reflection on the value of practicing

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection is generic ('it was helpful') with no specific part named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a specific part that would have been skipped and a plausible reason why.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection explains a concrete consequence of skipping that specific part in a real shared-living situation.

lookFors: The four checklist items and the task 3 list correspond to an actual conversation, not items copied verbatim from the topic list.
No specific real household income or real address is disclosed anywhere in the response.
The disagreement noted in task 3, if any, is described respectfully and specifically.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
